profile_text.body:
Character.AI, founded in 2022, operates an AI chat platform where users can converse with millions of AI characters. The company describes itself as offering "AI Chat, Reimagined" through what it calls the "#1 AI chat app."

The company's main product is Character.ai, a persona-based chat application built on large language models. The platform carries noted risks around appropriate use and human resources applications.
